text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as Christmas drew near. Dream 
Journey and the others were gathered, 
discussing the Christmas tree at their 
family home.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I still can't find it after all. That 
pewter ornament is essential for this 
year's tree, though.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Father and Mother are plotting a grand 
party to celebrate Sister's debut... An 
inferior tree would compromise my dignity 
as a king.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes... As I thought, I really want that 
"Phantom Pewter Craft," but—

text_block_list.name: Young Orfe
text_block_list.text:
That snowflake ornament... it's beautiful. 
It rivals even my father's creations.

text_block_list.name: Young Journey
text_block_list.text:
Is this pewter craft? The intricate 
patterns are quite beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, magnificent craftsmanship. I'd love to 
speak with the artisan directly... Where 
might they be?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Let's all look for it together! Orfe, 
Journey, you good with that?

text_block_list.name: Young Orfe
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Very well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"We asked around a lot and found the 
craftsman. Fufu... Dad was unusually 
talkative in front of him."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Even as a child, my heart would dance with 
excitement, like going on a treasure hunt.
choice_data_list: So it's a commemorative decoration, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Ah... it makes me want to 
get my hands on it all the more. Let's try 
looking into it from a different angle.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(—According to the investigation, the 
Eastern European workshop of "The Phantom 
Pewter" closed down when its craftsman 
retired.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(However... there is an apprentice in 
Japan who inherited the master's craft. 
Crushed by the master's overwhelming 
talent, it seems he currently makes a 
living wholesaling metal, but...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Rumor has it they've kept honing their 
craft. ...Shall we have them step back 
onto the main stage?)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
About that pewter craft... We managed to 
locate the apprentice, but apparently they 
aren't taking any commissions right now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of heading over to negotiate 
now. Would you mind accompanying me, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Sure, but... do you need me there...?
Sure, but... do you need me there...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I'm counting on you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by Dream Journey, we arrived at a 
workshop deep in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the workshop, a pewter 
snowflake craft catches my eye. Unwavering 
lines trace a delicate, intricate pattern, 
giving off a gentle gleam.

text_block_list.name: Pewtersmith
text_block_list.text: ...It's just a prototype. Basically junk.
choice_data_list: Oh gosh...! That was so moving!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I passionately explain that even without 
touching it, its smoothness and warmth 
seem to transmit straight through. The 
artisan offered a small smile in return.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Truly magnificent. Such master 
craftsmanship, breathing life into 
metal... Just like the pewter craft I saw 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Pewtersmith
text_block_list.text: ...Did you see that somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A long time ago... I saw them with my 
family at a market in Eastern Europe. We 
were completely captivated at first 
glance.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My whole family searched frantically for 
that artisan... and conveyed our 
overwhelming emotions to them. Fufu... it 
was tough, but it was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
When I learned you were an apprentice of 
that craftsman... I came to this shop. I 
wanted to spend time with my family just 
like that Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Pewtersmith
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, we aren't accepting custom 
orders at the moment. I apologize for not 
meeting your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... —Then, would it be possible 
for you to let me have that snowflake 
ornament over there?

text_block_list.name: Pewtersmith
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? But my work could never compare to 
Master's—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No. My father was a goldsmith, so I am 
quite confident in my eye for 
craftsmanship— and your work is truly 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It has a special brilliance that surpasses 
even Master's technique. A gentle light... 
that warms people's hearts. —Don't you 
think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It made me feel really happy too.
Yes. It made me feel really happy too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This radiance will bring our family the 
same joy... or perhaps even greater 
emotion than that day.

text_block_list.name: Pewtersmith
text_block_list.text:
"...To think you hold my work in such high 
regard... —Understood."

text_block_list.name: Pewtersmith
text_block_list.text:
Could you let me know your detailed 
requests? —I would love the chance to 
craft a new one for you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, the pewter ornament arrived. It 
truly is a magnificent piece.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please do come to the party. I would love 
for you to see it. After all, you are the 
greatest contributor.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Trainer. We were just putting up 
decorations.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is the brilliance. It matches 
the brilliance in my memories down to the 
finest detail.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Though it's a quiet piece, it commands a 
powerful presence... So this is what it 
means for a work of art to have a soul.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Those two are completely engrossed. 
Journey, thank you for a wonderful 
Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... You're quite welcome.
choice_data_list: I'm glad they liked it, aren't you?
Mind if I help with the decorating too?
Mind if I help with the decorating too?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... You're quite welcome.
choice_data_list: I'm glad they liked it, aren't you?
Mind if I help with the decorating too?
Mind if I help with the decorating too?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. This happy sight is exactly 
what I wanted to see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to you, Trainer. My 
heartfelt thanks for your exceptional 
work. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Then... would you please place 
the pewter star on top?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, guide it to completion with your 
own hands. Our greatest Christmas tree.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I doubt this one possesses any sense.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then please, follow Orfe's instructions. 
Fufu... I have high expectations of you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... I truly appreciate the 
sentiment, but you are our valued guest, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, make yourself comfortable. The 
party will begin shortly. ...Alright?
